parole.significato: A stringed instrument from Bengal resembling the mandolin.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Bengali দোতারা (dōtara) and Assamese দোতাৰা (dütara), from Persian دوتار (do târ) with the Bengali-Assamese suffix -আ (-a, “having, -ed”).

parole.significato: A traditional thin, coarse cotton cloth used in South Asia as a towel, scarf, loincloth, etc.
parole.testo: From Bengali গামুছা (gamucha) and Assamese গামোছা (gamüsa).
